A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DOUBLE study. The main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A-E are readable and matchable despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original speedup comparisons, component ablations, accuracy evaluations and deployment analyses in Section 5 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and appendix accuracy, profiling and resource-constrained evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithms 1-3 retain the same iterative draft retrieval, target-guided verification, parallel execution and hierarchical datastore procedures, including the greedy and stochastic verification rules.

E1.justification: HumanEval, GSM8K, CNN/DM, Alpaca, MT-Bench, the ShareGPT prior and the appendix deployment scenarios are unchanged. The newly discussed multimodal and agentic applications are future directions, not evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: SpS, Lookahead, PLD, Token Recycling, Ouroboros, PEARL, EAGLE-3 and the appendix NANO-PEARL/Vanilla comparisons are retained. Newly cited methods are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices C-D retain the same model configurations, hardware, metrics, batch sizes, temperature settings and testing procedures. Retrieval depth d=10, prior rounds K=10 and n-gram size n=3 are unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations, retrieval-depth and prior-size sweeps, rejected-cache ablation, losslessness checks, runtime profiling and batching/memory analyses already appear in v1 and remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Point-estimate reporting and the qualitative uncertainty explanation accompanying Table 6 are unchanged.

E6.justification: Result entries in Tables 1-10 and the empirical figures are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains HumanEval speedups of 5.33× for LLaMA3.3-70B and 2.84× for Qwen3-32B under the same settings.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, speedup derivations, Theorems 1-3, Appendix B proofs and Appendix D.2 losslessness reasoning are unchanged. Equation movement reflects text reflow.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free lossless decoding, overcoming the PSD speedup ceiling, resolving the retrieval trade-off and the headline speedups.

C2.justification: Appendix E adds prospective applicability discussion covering multimodal inference, agentic reasoning and further Transformer/hardware parallelism. Existing result interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, and these extensions are not demonstrated.

D1.justification: v2 adds a concrete repository link and code-availability statement in the abstract; v1 only promises a later release in Appendix C. That older promise remains in v2, creating inconsistent availability wording. Implementation details are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix E adds citations to LongSpec, Jakiro and TALON, plus literature supporting the new multimodal, agentic and systems directions; the EAGLE-2 citation and reference are removed. The established comparative taxonomy and central novelty argument remain intact.

P1.justification: v2 adds the abstract code statement, a funding Acknowledgements section and a future-work paragraph in Appendix E. The existing scientific narrative and section organization are largely preserved.

P2.justification: All eight figures and ten tables retain their content, captions and design. Added text causes limited column and page reflow around existing figures and equations; the expanded references shift the appendix pagination.

improvement.justification: The new repository pointer gives readers a concrete implementation location, and the funding acknowledgement improves transparency. These are limited documentation gains: experimental and theoretical support is unchanged, while Appendix C's retained future-release promise conflicts with the abstract's code-availability statement.
